compiled_state.title: As a DSO maintainer, I can verify that the bug classification pipeline is live end-to-end so that SC6 self-use is proven before epic closure
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Run the backfill script and /dso:retro during the 4911 sprint Phase I, capture and attach the outputs as artifacts, and confirm the SC6 self-use evidence before the completion-verifier closes the epic.
**Why**: SC6 mandates that both Phase G classification (via backfill) and /dso:retro aggregation are exercised against real 60-day data during the 4911 sprint. Without a story owning this, the completion-verifier will fail SC6 at epic closure with no clear owner for remediation.
**Scope**:
- IN: Sprint Phase I execution of backfill-bug-types.sh; sprint Phase I invocation of /dso:retro; capture and attach outputs as epic ticket comments; SC6 verification commands
- OUT: Creating the classifier, backfill script, or retro integration (owned by S2, S3, S4)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, backfill-bug-types.sh has been run during the 4911 sprint and at least one valid bug-type-<slug> tag (not uncategorized) has been written through the dispatched bug-classifier-haiku agent, verifiable via: .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --format=llm | python3 -c "import json,sys; ts=json.load(sys.stdin); print(sum(1 for t in ts for tag in (t.get('tags') or []) if tag.startswith('bug-type-')))" returning >= 1
  <- Satisfies: "SC6(a): backfill writes at least one valid bug-type-<slug> tag"
- When this story is complete, /dso:retro has been invoked during the 4911 sprint, used bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days 60, and the retro output contains EITHER >= 1 MUST-surface labeled finding (Slug recurrence:, Uncategorized bug count:, or Classifier failures detected:) OR the exact text "Bug classification health: no threshold breaches in this window."
  <- Satisfies: "SC6(b): retro aggregation path is live end-to-end"
- When this story is complete, both outputs (backfill run log and retro session output or artifact) are attached to the epic ticket as comments with the tag-count result and retro finding line cited explicitly
  <- Satisfies: SC6 verification evidence for dso:completion-verifier
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for any new script logic introduced by this story (e.g., a verification helper)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
